jsesh.tmp.mdcDisplayer.draw
Class ElementDrawer

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.tmp.mdcDisplayer.draw.ElementDrawer
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelElementVisitor
Direct Known Subclasses:
SimpleElementDrawer
public abstract class ElementDrawer
extends Object
implements ModelElementVisitor

Object responsible for drawing the basic elements from a text. It doesn't deal at all with sub-elements.
